docs.text: Happy to announce the start of my 2025 Fakemon project!!! I'll be designing an entire pokedex of fakemon that reside in the Laken region, inspired by the Great Lakes region of North America! This is a complete revamp of my 2023 fakemon project, all purely for fun! Stay tuned!
Introducing Lynn, mother of the Laken region's protagonist! Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
The early route mammal of the Laken region! 🦝 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!

Convergent Pokémon can be found in the Laken region as well! Shucklin resembles Applin, but is an entirely unrelated species! Its split evolutions are also quite different from Flapple and Appletun! Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
More regional variants in Laken! (New regional forms that replace the previous number 52 and 53 forms in my dex!) Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
Introducing the Grass type starter of the Laken region, Blossomole! 🍃 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
The early route bird of the Laken region! 🐦 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
More convergent Pokémon! Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
ROCK. Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
There are four Great Lakes in the Laken region. Lurefry will evolve into a different form depending on which of these lakes it was caught in! 🎣 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
Introducing the Water type starter of the Laken region, Hissyfit! 🌊 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
Introducing the Fire type starter of the Laken region, Pindle! 🔥 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!

Introducing the Laken region's fossil....Pokémon? Umm, is it supposed to look like that? Well, fossil researcher Clu Liss says it's accurate, so I guess it's fine! Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!
FROGS!!!! 🐸 Part of my Great Lakes fakemon pokedex project!

Hear me out, and I’m still cooking here: Great Lakes Region in Pokémon. Starting somewhere in Unova, you trek West around Ontario, Erie, and Huron. You acquire Surf pretty late, so you can cross Lake Michigan to Wisconsin. Elite 4 is in Chicago. DLC in Ontario. I have ideas for Pokémon already ofc

- Riolu (from a breeder) - Ambipom (work related)
- Wattrel (Caught during its migration through the Great Lakes region)
- Miltank (Lots of farms around here) - Foongus (Also plenty of forests here)
